# Dusrel

> Dusrel builds free, privacy-first apps: an image compressor/resizer, an LRC lyrics maker, a resume builder, and PDF tools. Apps run locally in the browser wherever possible — no accounts, no tracking, no data selling. Motto: "YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS". The site is available in English and Hindi (Hindi pages live under /hi/).

## Apps

- [ShrinkIt](https://dusrel.com/apps/shrinkit/): Free image compressor and resizer that runs 100% in the browser. Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and AVIF, resize by percent, pixels or target file size, batch up to 50 images, EXIF metadata stripped automatically.
- [Ricsline](https://dusrel.com/apps/ricsline/): Free LRC lyrics maker in the browser. Tap-to-sync timing with millisecond precision, built-in lyrics library, offset and inline editing, export .lrc, clipboard or JSON.
- [ResumeForge](https://dusrel.com/apps/resumeforge/): Free resume builder with 20 templates, live A4 preview with page-break markers, print-ready PDF download, autosave in the browser. Data never leaves the device.
- [PDF Tools](https://dusrel.com/apps/pdf-tools/): Free in-browser PDF tools — merge, organize, rotate, JPG to PDF, page numbers, watermark and more (11 tools). Files are processed locally and never uploaded.
- [All Dusrel apps](https://dusrel.com/apps/): The full app index, including upcoming apps.

## Downloads

- [Download ShrinkIt](https://dusrel.com/apps/shrinkit/download/): All ShrinkIt download options (free, no signup).
- [ShrinkIt for Chrome](https://dusrel.com/apps/shrinkit/download/chrome/): Chrome extension (also Edge/Brave), version 1.0.0, manual ZIP install with step-by-step guide and FAQ. A Chrome Web Store release is coming soon.

## Tools

- [Free Online Tools](https://dusrel.com/pass/): All Dusrel tools in one place — everything runs locally in the browser.
- [Password Generator](https://dusrel.com/pass/password-generator/): Strong, random passwords generated locally with the Web Crypto API. Adjustable length (8–64), character types, exclude look-alikes, live entropy/strength meter. Nothing is sent to a server.
- [Username Generator](https://dusrel.com/pass/username-generator/): Catchy username ideas for social media and gaming. Themed word pairs (Cool, Nature, Tech), separators, number suffixes, click to copy. Availability is not checked.
- [Word Counter](https://dusrel.com/pass/word-counter/): Live word, character (with/without spaces), sentence and paragraph counts plus reading time at 200 wpm. Text never leaves the browser.
- [QR Code Generator](https://dusrel.com/pass/qr-code-generator/): Free static QR codes for any link or text, downloadable as PNG up to 1024px. No watermark, no expiry, no tracking redirect.
- [Age Calculator](https://dusrel.com/pass/age-calculator/): Exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth, as of any date — plus total days/weeks lived and next-birthday countdown.
- [Password Strength Checker](https://dusrel.com/pass/password-strength-checker/): Entropy score, estimated crack time at 10 billion guesses/sec and pattern feedback for any password — checked 100% locally.
